title: Topic 4
japanese_text:
Ａ：その桜の浴衣、<u>淡い</u>ピンク色できれいだね。
Ｂ：ありがとう。<u>一目ぼれして</u>買ったんだ。桜が散っているデザインって、ちょっと<u>儚い</u>感じがするよね。
english_translation:
A: That cherry blossom yukata is so beautiful in pale pink.
B: Thank you. I fell in love with it at first sight, so I bought it. The scattered cherry blossom design feels a bit wistful, doesn't it?

annotated_words.meaning_en: instant love, fall in love at first sight
